source: MSP430FR6007/FR6005 datasheet SLASEV3A (p.29), section 8.5 Typical Characteristics, Active Mode Supply Currents. Written cold from the frozen page render (200 DPI) before scoring. Marked points sit at f = 1, 4, 8 MHz (the printed x markers).

plots.title: 8.5 Typical Characteristics, Active Mode Supply Currents

series.name: I(AM,RAMonly)
series.condition: program and data in RAM, FRAM off

plots.anchor_notes: The printed equation is a closed-form extraction target: at f = 8 MHz it evaluates to 1028 µA, consistent with the digitized I(AM,75%) endpoint (~1000) within digitization error. Footnotes A/B define the cache-hit-ratio and RAM-only conditions — the series condition field should keep them.

notes: Acceptance gold for the typical-curves lane: axis-label exact >= 0.95, series-count exact >= 0.90, sampled-point error <= 2% of y-axis span. Points sample identifiable features only (the printed x markers at 1/4/8 MHz here). printed_equation is captured for the formula-extraction extension (fill-only: null when no formula is printed). Label strings recovered verbatim from the page text layer (deterministic word-run joins); digitized points remain hand-labeled from the frozen render.
